title: Rename Guid To Id Across Semio
description: Rename guid to id everywhere within semio: code, assets, tests, specs, schemas, docs, and bindings. This is a breaking rename with no backwards compatibility. Update runtime models, DTOs, APIs, OpenAPI/JSON Schema/OWL/XMI/docs, shared assets, and tests so the semio subtree consistently uses id instead of guid. Validate affected builds/tests and close out with the files changed.
